newsitem.title: USA: Marathon, Ashland look at venture.
newsitem.headline: Marathon, Ashland look at venture.

text.p: USX Corp said Thursday it agreed with with Ashland Inc to pursue a combination of the major elements of USX-Marathon Group's and Ashland's refining, marketing and transportation operations.

Under terms of a letter of intent, USX-Marathon would have a 62 percent ownership and Ashland would have a 38 percent ownership in a joint venture which is expected to be formed following regulatory reviews and approval of definitive agreements and approval by the boards of USX and Ashland.
Marathon and Ashland have agreed that exploration, production and chemical businesses are not to be a part of the new venture, USX said in a statement.

Other exclusions include Ashland's Valvoline division, along with equity investments in certain pipelines for both companies. Ashland's refinery-produced petrochemicals will become part of the joint venture.

The venture's headquarters would be located in Findlay, Ohio, and J. L. "Corky" Frank, currently Marathon's executive vice president, refining, marketing and transportation, would become president of the yet-unnamed entity.
Ashland's Duane Gilliam, currently Ashland Petroleum executive vice president, will be appointed as executive vice president for the joint venture, USX said.

Current plans are to maintain the existing brand identification for each company. Marathon markets under the Marathon brand name and through its Emro Marketing Co brands: Speedway, Bonded, Cheker, Starvin' Marvin, United, Gastown, Wake Up and Kwik Sak. Ashland brands include: Ashland, Super America and Rich Oil.
Future decisions on brand identification or consolidation may be undertaken by the new company, USX said.
